$comment: Machine-readable companion to baseline.md. Commands reproduce the full M0 baseline; they are not all required for routine development. Every command is argv + env rather than a shell string.

performancePolicy.reviewTriggerMeaning: Approximate trigger for repeat measurement and investigation of total time or material allocation regressions; not an automatic hard-fail threshold.
performancePolicy.fullMatrix: Baseline refresh, milestone/release verification, optimized-variant adoption, major runtime changes, or regression investigation.

cpu.featuresNote: sdk/dsp.HasAVX2/HasAVX2FMA gate SIMD dispatch in the FLAC/PCM/MP3 codec packages; on a machine without these features, the 'simd' build variant exercises the same scalar path as 'scalar' regardless of GODEC_FORCE_SCALAR, so a semantic comparison across variants is only meaningful on hardware where avx2/avx2fma are both true.

workspace.rootPackageCountNote: Counted with `go list ./...` at baselineCommit, root module only. Later milestones add packages, so a count taken at HEAD is expected to be larger and is not a setup error.

buildVariants.name: simd-forced-scalar
buildVariants.requiredForBaselineNote: Exercises sdk/dsp's forced-scalar dispatch path inside a SIMD-capable build. Useful as an optional diagnostic; not required to consider M0's baseline reproduced -- scalar and simd alone establish per-variant build/test correctness.

stereoBlock.description: Deterministic pseudo-random 2-channel float32 audio.Block, sample values in [-1, 1).
stereoBlock.note: Fixed seeds (not runtime/OS-seeded, which is math/rand/v2's package-level default) so the same size tier produces byte-identical input on every run and every machine.

flacFrameFixture.description: A single hardcoded FLAC STREAMINFO + frame, hex-decoded once, reused as 64 packets per iteration. No randomness; fully deterministic by construction.

observationPairedFixture.description: Synthetic fixed-size 4096-byte frames totalling 64MiB. No randomness; fully deterministic by construction.

benchmarks.note: Reports built-in metrics for coarse regression detection and processing-ns/op for lifecycle diagnosis.
Uses the same workload shape as benchFilterChain, but its sequential execution means the difference also includes the pipeline's concurrency benefit; it is not a strict overhead lower bound.

profiles.note: Substitute the trailing benchmark path segment (Off) with Plain, Progress, or Metrics to profile another mode.
